'''s()l(), Han Dust 'n echoes''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[s()l(), Han]]
* '''Published:''' 16 November 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Theme/Fun
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' —
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Heading For The Medical Frigate|DS2-L-headingforthemedicalfrigate.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Dust 'n echoes
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed DE Han LS 2004 GPN.txt |Download]] (omits Throne room: no GEMP blueprint)

== Introduction ==

This is a fun deck that I play in some fun classics. The players I play with use classic rules but with one exception NO (V) cards I know I know I thought that it was BS when I heard it, but it is really fun and is a challenge!

The published list has 57 cards.

The post also lists 1x Throne room, which matches no known card; it is shown as posted and counted in the published total.

== Notes ==

* Qty 57 as published: the Interrupts header says 16 but the list has 15; the other sections have no counts. The author's 'edit' swaps (Lightsaber Proficiency, Anakin's saber and Staging Areas out; Revolution and 2x Out Of Commission & Transmission Terminated in) are not applied.
* UNKNOWN: the starting location 'Throne room' could be Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room (already listed under Locations) or Naboo: Theed Palace Throne Room; shown as posted.
* Classic format with no (V) cards (stated in the post). Posted Obi's crib dested Tatooine: Obi-Wan's Hut; Houjix combo dested Houjix & Out Of Nowhere; Sense combo dested Sense & Recoil In Fear; Staging areas combo dested Your Insight Serves You Well & Staging Areas.

== Strategy ==

peeps dont see that one of the rules for the guys i play with is that it is classic format and no (V) cards!

edit: 1x lightsaber prof., Anis saber, and  staging areas(couldnt acquire one) out

1x revolution in , 2x OOC and trans terminated in

Strategy

Well staging areas gives you a little extra activation while you try to get ur Twix sites out. After that you can pull honor of the Jedi if you didn’t get it.

There are two things to this deck: A butload of activation… and a few broken cards. This is all about using the cards tech! With this deck there are so many destiny adders that I decided I needed to add some cards that will slow your opponent down right after he draws... this is oola and leesub. Get them together and they are pretty useful. Basically what I do is try to deploy them to some site that is out of the way with either a houjix, or rebel barrier in hand. You reveal their hand and boot out their male characters and then you have a good idea of what is left in their hand to make an educated guess with leesub! This deck I designed to be a basic bag of tricks.

You have a few drain modifiers Ani’s stick and the lightsaber proficiencies which BTW turn ur epps into tanks. Also use traffic control to recycle your cards and bolster your wins.

This deck is pretty straight forward steal their sites, use ur tech cards, and LEAVE NO ONE ALIVE!!!
